kv4.2:4.3: Hañci saha uppattiyā sotāpanno na hoti, no vata re vattabbe
kv4.2:5.3: Hañci saha uppattiyā sakadāgāmī na hoti, no vata re vattabbe
kv4.2:6.3: Hañci saha uppattiyā anāgāmī na hoti, no vata re vattabbe
kv4.2:7.3: Sāriputto thero saha uppattiyā Arahā ti?
kv4.2:7.9: Mahā Panthako thero saha uppattiyā Arahā ti?
kv4.2:8.1: Sāriputto thero na saha uppattiyā Arahā ti?
kv4.2:8.3: Hañci Sāriputto thero na saha uppattiyā Arahā, no vata re vattabbe
kv4.2:9.2: Mahā Kassapo thero, Mahā Kaccāyano thero, Mahā Koṭṭhiko thero --pe--
kv4.2:9.5: Mahā Panthako thero na saha uppattiyā Arahā ti?
kv4.2:9.7: Hañci Mahā Panthako thero na saha uppattiyā Arahā, no vata re vattabbe
kv4.2:10.3: Uppattesiyena cittena arahattaṃ sacchikaroti lokiyena sāsavena --pe-- saṃkilesikenāti?
kv4.2:11.3: Uppattesiyaṃ cittaṃ niyyānikaṃ khayagāmī bodhagāmī apacayagāmī anāsavaṃ --pe--
kv4.2:12.1: Nanu uppattesiyaṃ cittaṃ aniyyānikaṃ, na khayagāmī, na bodhagāmī, na apacayagāmī, sāsavaṃ --pe--
kv4.2:12.4: Hañci uppattesiyaṃ cittaṃ aniyyānikaṃ, na khayagāmī, na bodhagāmī, na apacayagāmī, sāsavaṃ --pe-- saṃkilesikaṃ, no vata re vattabbe
kv4.2:13.3: Uppattesiyena cittena rāgaṃ pajahati, dosaṃ pajahati, mohaṃ pajahati, --pe-- anottappaṃ pajahatīti?
kv4.2:14.3: Uppattesiyaṃ cittaṃ maggo --pe-- satipaṭṭhānaṃ sammappadhānaṃ iddhipādo indriyaṃ balaṃ --pe-- bojjhaṅgo ti?
kv4.2:15.3: Uppattesiyena cittena dukkhaṃ parijānāti, samudayaṃ pajahati, nirodhaṃ sacchikaroti, maggaṃ bhāvetīti?
kv4.2:15.7: Cuticittaṃ, maggacittaṃ, uppattesiyaṃ cittaṃ, phalacittan ti?
